answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the kernel of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. A thread of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vault of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
